title: Olon Collection Document
description: COP collection document: a keyed record of entities independent from pages. Keys are stable entity identifiers; values must include the same stable `id` field.

CollectionItem.description: Base shape for a collection entity. Tenant-specific fields are allowed as additional properties and are validated by the tenant collection schema.

id.description: Stable collection item identifier. Must match the item key in its parent collection document and is used for routing, React keys, and agent addressing.
